description: This file contains data model classes, enums, and related data structures for user profiles, reminders, BMI records, AI suggestions, and notifications in the core module of a wellness app.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Represents a user's profile and basic health/goal data.

classes.name: Reminder
classes.description: Encapsulates reminder configuration for a specific habit.

classes.name: ReminderType
classes.description: Types of reminders supported by the app.

classes.name: DayOfWeek
classes.description: Day of week abstraction to avoid Android enum dependencies in core.

classes.name: BmiRecord
classes.description: A BMI record point for trend analysis.

classes.name: AiSuggestion
classes.description: An AI suggestion for motivation or habit optimization.

classes.name: SuggestionCategory
classes.description: Types of AI suggestions to categorize content.

classes.name: AppNotification
classes.description: Notification payload for motivational or reminder notifications.

classes.name: NotificationChannel
classes.description: Notification channels used by the system.
